text.aria-label: Subtitle text '16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Mean over the half- hours outside labelled switching and logged closures that every arm holds (2,928,842 cases). Dot: mean score. The paired contrasts in figure 1 are much tighter than the uncertainty of any one dot, so no interval is drawn here.'
text.tspan: 16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Mean over the half-
hours outside labelled switching and logged closures that every arm holds (2,928,842 cases).
Dot: mean score. The paired contrasts in figure 1 are much tighter than the uncertainty of
any one dot, so no interval is drawn here.
